format: Two parts, separate scripts. PART A 45: Q1 any 3 of 4 x5 | Q2 any 3 of 4 x5 | Q3 either (a) or (b) 15. PART B 25: Q1 either a/b 5 | Q2 compulsory 5 | Q3 either (a) or (b) 15.
note: Two-part paper = likely two teachers. Part B (compression LZW 4x5, lossy 3x3 +2) reappears almost word-for-word in SP25 Q3b.

questions.text: With neat cross-section of human eye, describe the functions of its main components pertaining to visual system.
Define image sensor. With neat sketches, describe image acquisition by different arrangements of sensors.
With neat sketches, briefly describe Neighborhood, Connectivity and Regions of an image pixel.
With neat diagrams, describe the image reconstruction using CT.
Figure: 2-D rectangular pulse with added white noise. Find the Fourier spectrum of the pulse and draw the output when the image passed through an ideal LPF and also an ideal HPF.
Table [[1,2,0],[3,3,2],[5,6,4],[7,0,1]] represents an image. Find the output if this image is subjected to filtering with arithmetic and geometric mean filters.
4x4 pixel intensities [[0,2,3,4],[1,3,5,0],[3,2,6,7],[5,2,7,0]]. Transform using gamma transformation with gamma=0.4 and 2.5 and discuss the effect of changing gamma.
Image I composed of set A (V-shaped object) and background; with reasoning and neat sketches find the opening and closing of the image by the (disk) structuring element B.

(i) 3-bit image 32x32, n_k = [120,240,160,50,100,100,210,44] for r_k=0..7. Get the histogram equalization transformation function and draw original and equalized histograms [8]. (ii) Specified histogram p_z(z_q) = [0,0,0.15,0.20,0.25,0.20,0.10,0.10]; find the histogram (specification) transformation function and draw it [7].

(i) Define histogram equalization and explain its effects. Show that transformation of intensity histogram results in a uniform PDF. p_r(r)=r^2/(L-1)^2 (0<=r<=L-1). Find the transformation function for equalizing; also find the transformation producing p_z(z)=z^3/(L-1)^2 [9]. (ii) Derive the expression of the 2-D Fourier transform of a box function; draw its magnitude spectrum [6].
Draw the RGB color cube using the Cartesian coordinate system. How are different colors and gray scales formed in the RGB color model?
Draw different HSI models. Explain how HSI is calculated from a color model.
Four-symbol source {a,b,c,d} with probabilities {0.1,0.4,0.3,0.2}. Find the single encoded value of the sequence 'bbadc' using the arithmetic encoding technique.

i) Encode the border of the region (grid figure) and check if the CFD number remains the same from different starting points (2,2), (4,4), (8,2); 8-directional chain [7]. ii) Image strip 50x100 with five vertical stripes, gray levels 128,64,32,16,8, widths 35,30,20,10,5. Coded by Huffman coding: determine its efficiency [8].

i) Compress bitmap images with repeating colors/patterns using LZW fixed-length coding: encode the 4x5 8-bit image [5 8 8 40 120] (4 identical rows), step by step [10]. ii) Image [1,4,3,2,3,4,2,4,5], 3x3, 3 bits, lossy; after decompression all pixels +2. Calculate root-mean-square error as fidelity criteria. Compare the compression ratio and the entropy of the original image [5].
